text.description_html:
Omnia AP-722/400-US32D, 17-Inch Designer Appliance Pull

This 17 inch Designer Brushed Stainless Steel Appliance Pull has as ultra modern appearance that is great for contemporary kitchens. it has a unique shape that really lends itself well to one of the busiest areas of your home--your kitchen. The solid rectangular stainless steel refrigerator pull from Omnia is just the right size for your Sub Zero refrigerator. The Brushed Satin Stainless finish requires little maintenance. It has a 15-3/4 inch center to center and a 2-9/16 inch projection.

Also Available Designer Brushed Stainless Steel Door Pull

Specifications for the Omnia AP-722/400-US32D Designer Refrigerator/Appliance Pull:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Center to Center Mount: 15-3/4" (c.c.)
  • Overall Length: 17-5/16"
  • Projection: 2-9/16"
  • Rectangular Bar Thickness: 3/8"
  • Rectangular Bar Height: 1"
  • Mounting Bracket Diameter: 1"
  • Pull Mounting: Standard 3/4" Thick Appliance Panel

Sold Individually
